description: This file defines extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization using System.Text.Json, specifically adding methods to convert objects to and from JSON strings with case-insensitive property names.

classes.name: JsonExtensions
classes.description: Contains static extension methods for serializing objects to JSON and deserializing JSON strings to objects, using a shared JsonSerializerOptions instance.

methods.name: FromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an object of type T, utilizing the shared _jsonOptions for case-insensitive property matching.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object of type T into its JSON string representation, using the shared _jsonOptions.
